-Player 2's tab menu should now display their items correctly in co-op

notes.title: Release Update #3
notes.content:
Some updates:
-The new character now has bullet effects and can crit- because of this, crit rate no longer increases their rotation speed
-Some useless items removed from the new character's item pool
-Brainiac only spends extra meter when firing a single shot
-Trumpets quiet down earlier in the Sun area
-Can no longer use items while disabled
-Added the Dual Orbiter to the planet item pool, and the Bounty to the regular item pool
-Removed the last Sun treasure (for now)
-Orion can now find Bouncing Bullets


And some bugfixes:
-Added some missing items that don't get saved through death in casual mode (character specific items like Trinity and Whirlwing Ring)
-Grav Zone no longer moves planets
-Remote Shopper drops items directly on the player that uses it, cant be used with 0 charges and recharges per floor correctly
-Frozen runts and bats now get affected properly by push/pull effects (Vortex, Slugger, Riptide etc)
-Escort mission no longer appears in the Starry Sea

Hope you are enjoying the game so far! Remember that Discord is the best place to share bugs and suggestions, as well as share runs and info!

notes.title: Release patch #2
notes.content:
Hope everyone is having a good time with the game- here are some bugfixes that are now live:

Today's patch:
-Hydra should now spawn small enemies to infest in all of the bossfights
-Orion should now regain his chakram if without it for 8 seconds in a bossfight
-Removed some areas where chakrams, players or enemies could potentially get stuck in walls
-Some music overlaps should now be fixed, as well as a desync on the Colosseum soundtrack
-Venus now attacks faster after bullets cleared

There was also a patch yesterday with the following:
-Mini Drones should no longer break the casual save file
-Chakram should no longer get stuck outside of the Monolith boss fight
-Chakram should now respawn in Saturn's boss room- and enter-room effects now happen when entering Saturn's boss room
-Hive Mind should no longer delete enemies when changing targets
-The Starry Sea black screen is now removed
-Deleting your save file should reset your current character back to Pluto
-Prismatic Shot and Railgun items now have their sprites added
-Recall Whistle now always costs a charge even if there's nothing to recall
-Fixed a bug causing the Perfect Challenge rescue cage to not open
-Enemies get feared for less time the more times they get feared (cant permanently stun bosses with fear)

A couple of known issues with fixes on the way:
-Picking an active item from the chest while already having one equipped may cause both to fire at once, can be fixed by swapping your equipped item once
-Loading into the hub from the title screen, then returning to title screen, then returning to the hub can cause the title screen music to overlap the hub theme. Pausing and unpausing the game will fix this for now

As always, Discord is the best place to report bugs! Thanks for your patience!

notes.title: Asterogues 1.0 is releasing soon!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Asterogues 1.0 is arriving on November 20th![/b] [/h1]
The pathway to the Sun is finally opening for you to take your revenge!

☀️ This update also contains a ton of new items, bumping the total up to 250+, new enemies, a new area, and a new playable character! You can also recruit rebels along your path to help you in the final fight. Bonus zones are accessible for a chance to pick up more help and items, but are defended by one of the missing planets!

🗺️ The world of Asterogues has been improved! Items have been reworked, as well as chests- not all chests require keys now, but instead have different properties. Items now stack on top of each other in the inventory, and you'll be stacking up items more frequently- runs now feel very different from each other with very different highs!
Some of the hardest enemies and bosses have been nerfed a little, mainly removing some unfair situations, but the game is still very challenging.
The hub can be upgraded with various features that can spice up your runs also, based on your playstyle.
Also, many characters and items have received tweaks and balancing prods to make them feel better, stronger, and improve quality of life.

This game has been in development for a few years and I'm excited to finally give the 1.0 over to you! I really hope you enjoy it, and that the last few months of quiet while I pulled it together was worth the wait! Until then, feel free to join the Discord to see some updates leading up to the day, and wishlist so you don't forget when it drops!

[previewyoutube=GunWThgJagI;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2083240/Asterogues/

notes.title: New minibosses and bugfixing
notes.content:
Hi all, this is a small patch aimed at fixing some bugs mainly. There are also two new minibosses that can be found in the early areas to try out.

Additions:
2 new minibosses!
Braniac now has custom items (that can also be found at the Fortune teller)

Balance:
Orion can no longer find Toxic Bullet, since it was so terrible on him.

Fixes:
[list]
[*] Multiplayer- should now be back up and running!
[*] Fortune Teller- fixed a bug in this room where Braniac and rerolling would softlock the game
[*] Fixed a bug where chests could softlock or offer empty slots later in the run

[*] Keys should now properly discount in the HP shop, reducing the cost by 1 HP
[*] Laika's shop dialogue now properly offers all 3 options (reroll, key, quit)
[*] Rerolling in the shop now uses a ticket if it is in your inventory
[*] Shop tickets now allow items to spawn of any tier (was causing a bug where the shop level was too high to offer items of the ticket type)
[*] Fixed bug where the Earth's moon would glow and get giant

[*] Casual mode- should now retain all newer items added in the last patch between deaths.
[*] Casual mode- keys and rerolls now are retained between deaths.

[*] Some enemies that weren't triggering on-hit effects, like the Armoured runts, will now do so properly.

[*] In ultra-widescreen, fixed the background not stretching the full length of the screen
[/list]

More content on the way!

notes.title: Earth Update!
notes.content:
Hi everyone- there’s a new update dropping right now!
Here’s a breakdown of what’s in the new update:

-[b]New playable character[/b] Orion!
-[b]New world[/b]- the Moon Base!
[b]6 new room types[/b] to play with, and new expansions to shops!
[b]Keys[/b] are a new mechanic that'll switch up how you play your run!

[b]Difficulty[/b]- the game was frankly too hard, and has been rebalanced- a hard version of the game is still available with the hard mode toggle!

[b]Runs improved[/b]- The worlds are shorter, and runs now include every world, so you can fight all of the planets in one run- or, you can take a detour!

[b]Enemies[/b]- A rework of how enemies spawn, making things both easier and more fun. New enemies now available in various zones, and a new planet boss!

[b]Items[/b]- New active item charge system that works off damage as well as kills, so now items feel more involved for boss fights- plus active items can be held in the inventory and swapped between! A rework of ice and poison to make them into fun item routes! A few new items, with another item drop around the corner!

[b]General overall polish[/b] with ui, music, and cutscenes! Various bugfixes, improvements to different resolutions and hopefully performance!

Thanks everyone for your feedback over the past few months since EA dropped. I think the game has grown a million times better than it would have if I had worked privately up until full release- and I still have a lot more to add before the game is finished. As always, please share your feedback with me on Discord!
I hope you enjoy this new version of Asterogues!
[img]https://i.imgur.com/XEp8H80.png[/img]

notes.title: Patch #4
notes.content:
Hi all!

This patch is mostly focused on requested QOL changes with some new items too.
In other news, did you know we have a Wiki? We are currently in the process of adding to it- here’s the link if you want to visit or help fill it out: https://asterogues.wiki.gg/wiki/Asterogues_Wiki


[h3][b]Jupiter:[/b][/h3]
[list][*] Fixed a bug with Jupiter crashing the game when he dies in certain situations
[/list]
[h3][b]New Items:[/b][/h3]
The tavern is getting some new options for its customers!
[list][*] Added the[b] Star Sour[/b], [b]White Martian[/b], [b]Moonshine[/b], [b]Gravitini[/b], [b]Glimmerlet[/b], [b]Dark Matter Mix[/b] to drinks
[/list]Planet chests have a new item pool including some items that may have not shown up before.
[list][*] Added more items to the boss item pool that weren’t showing in runs due to their high tier - [b]Big Stick, Burst Engine, Neptune’s Trident, Toy Blaster, Pheromone, Repeater [/b]
[/list]
[h3][b]QOL Updates/Bugfixes:[/b][/h3]
The inventory and UI has been improved. Still a work in progress that will continue to be improved, but here are the new additions:
[list][*] Pause when opening the inventory
[*] New aiming reticle
[*] You can now choose your game resolution in the settings menu (with mouse)
[*] Inventory works for all resolutions nicely (this might not apply to ultra wide resolutions)
[*] Inventory system shows temporary effects (such as drinks)
[*] Drinks now list the amount of rooms they last
[*] Inventory now shows all stats even if they are 0, so they can be read before buying items etc
[*] Cutscene bars work for all resolutions
[*] Fixed a spacing problem with active item's description
[*] When opening inventory on controller, automatically hovers first available item slot (works if the first item is passive, or a cursed hub item too)
[*] Removed the hover sprite recolor when selecting your run mode
[*] [b]Bugfix[/b]: Fixed a navigation bug with cursed hub items on controller in the inventory
[/list]
The graphics have been improved with new fx added to certain items. More to come!
[list][*] Bubble bullets resized to match pixel size of the game
[*] New attack animations for [b]Asteroy, Frostar, Asterbomination, Cultrunt[/b]- some enemies now pause during their attack windup
[*] New landing warning animation for enemies and bounce on landing
[*] New graphics for [b]Bullet Tech[/b] aiming effect and also now works for Void Bullets
[*] [b]Star Ring[/b] has new effects when injured
[*] [b]Overcharged Star[/b] new adds new electric trail effect to Homing bullets
[*] Each character has their own face sprite for the sidemap, as well as the death progress screen
[*] [b]Explosive Bullets[/b] have a new explode effect
[/list]
Chests and item drops have been improved a bit. In particular people were asking for an option for passive items in the first chest.
[list][*] First chest will offer at least one active and one passive item.
[*] Less active items can drop at a store
[*] You can click to select item in chest instead of using E
[*] [b]Bugfix[/b]: Fixed a bug where rerolled items weren't affected by price decrease
[/list]
An improvement to stop players dying after beating a boss.
[list][*] Players can’t take damage while the screen whites out (after boss fight)
[/list]
To help players unlock new characters:
[list][*] Locked characters now have a locked sprite at the hub, with a hint towards their unlock method
[/list]
[h3][b]Balance Updates:[/b][/h3]
[list][*] Hydra is now immune for 0.4 seconds on leaving a host
[*] Hydra's infest range from 2.5 to 2.7
[*] Movement item class has changed- used to lower enemy movespeed- now increases player movespeed
[*] Cursed Hub Items now grant either +3% or +6% coins dropped as a beneficial passive
[*] Mars' challenger minibosses drop a heart on death each
[*] Planet Chests now drop hearts even if you took no/little damage
[*] [b]Burning Sword[/b]- now grants burning after a kill combo with new fire fx
[*] [b]Electro Prod[/b]- now applies lightning every 3rd melee attack with new electric fx
[*] [b]Leafblower[/b] now blows less powerfully but has a different, more consistent conversion of bullets to hit opponents
[*] [b]Corrosion Point[/b] has a bigger hit area (0.001->0.3 radius) and new animation
[*] [b]Astro Suit[/b] now also has a 20% chance to block bullets as well as extreme fire and ice resistance
[*] [b]Repeater[/b] reload chance increased from 20 to 30%. Also updated text to clarify it has the same chance to double-use pickups
[*] Changed Headsplitter to a new effect: take +1 damage when hit, heal 3 HP at the end of this effect
[*] Cultrunt bullet now does 6 damage to enemies instead of 2 when Pluto fires it
[*] Sickle and Bouncing Bullets can be recaught after they bounce (by Pluto, Void)
[*] Crates now have a slightly higher chance of dropping an unusual Heart (1/5 to 1/4)
[*] Sandworms now create bullets that don’t go through obstacles
[*] Dronewalker laser now creates bullets at its tip
[*] Raiderunts (on Jupiter) are a bit slower (2.5movespeed -> 2.2) and fire a bit slower (7 -> 6.5)
[*] Neptune's bubble bullets explode into less bullets (50->40)
[/list]

Thanks everyone who’s been playing and reporting bugs as well as leaving suggestions. This is the last big QOL patch before moving on to new content! The best place to talk to me is on the Asterogues [url=https://discord.gg/uPacfKDsnA]Discord[/url]. 


Known issues:
[list][*] Can’t change resolution with controller
[*] Resolution may not display the correct starting resolution and may not save between sessions
[*] Can’t reach discord/twitter etc buttons on the main screen with controller
[*] Music can be turned off during a bossfight by pausing as it fades in
[*] Some music tracks can end up playing over each other
[/list]

Mark 

Follow me on 
[url=https://twitter.com/m3smay]Twitter [/url]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2083240/Asterogues/

notes.title: Patch #3
notes.content:
Hi everyone- This patch is broken into two parts- there’s a retweak of playable characters and run difficulty overall, and then a sizable amount of QOL changes + bugfixes. Most of these are reported from Discord and Steam forums! 

[b]In other news, did you know we have a Wiki? We are currently in the process of adding to it- here’s the link if you want to visit or help fill it out:[/b] [url=https://asterogues.wiki.gg/wiki/Asterogues_Wiki]Asterogues Official Wiki[/url]

[h3][b]Balancing:[/b][/h3]
The main goal for balance changes is to make the game more fun rather than to make all the characters equally strong. The idea behind nerfs is to remove situations where the character is so strong that it no longer interacts with the game.

[b]Pluto [/b]is getting some changes to feel more fair. He gets punished heavily for getting hit and some players feel like he doesn’t catch every bullet in his orbit. Pluto only catches bullets that spend enough time near him, so it was possible for fast bullets to quickly pass through without being caught in orbit.
[list]
[*]Pluto only drops half of orbiting bullets when hit.
[*]Pluto orbit mechanics updated to catch bullets that pass through orbit range too quickly.
[/list]
[b]Void [/b]is going to do slightly less damage while also having a slightly tighter cone, just so it's slightly less destructive in basic rooms and also can hit bosses a tiny bit better.
[list]
[*]Void pulse cone angle reduced by 20%.
[*]Void bullet damage from 1.8 to 1.6.
[*]Void boss hp reduction multiplier from 0.7x to 0.85x (bosses have more hp vs void).
[/list]
[b]Hydra [/b]is going to shred bosses a bit less quickly while also having to get a tiny bit closer to infest enemies. In the last patch Hydra’s damage was boosted by crits being fixed on it, so this evens it out. Hydra also got a new method of recovering shields when fighting bosses but was taking little to no damage in return, so this was fixed.
[list]
[*]Hydra boss hp reduction multiplier from 0.65x to 0.9x (bosses have more hp vs hydra).
[*]Hydra infest range from 3 to 2.6 (break range remains the same).
[*]Hydra now takes the right amount of damage from bosses.
[/list]
[b]Braniac[/b] was trivializing his own mechanics when finding certain items that changed his bullets, so these items are going to be less effective on him.
[list]
[*]Braniac now has a 15% proc chance for bullet-changing items (Bouncy Bullets, Goldeneye etc.) and a 3% proc chance on Space Freezer.
[*]Laser Lasso no longer drops for Braniac.
[/list]
[b]The strongest enemies are getting a slight tweak to be more manageable.[/b]
[list]
[*]Frostar only fires one bomb at a time.
[*]Helmetrunts don’t jump all the time, and walk for a little bit between jumps.
[*]Harder minibosses now drop less/no additional enemies when they spawn.
[*]Phobos and Mars shields now have 8HP and can be destroyed.
[/list]
[i][b]Freeze was leaving the player without much to do when freezing the source of bullets, so you can now melee frozen enemies for big damage. Freeze might be damage-tweaked later since it now works fine against planets[/b][/i].
[list]
[*]Frozen enemies now take 4x melee damage.
[/list]
[b]Sun Amulet[/b] radius increased from 5.8 to 6.8.

[h3][b]Controller Updates:[/b][/h3]
Controller auto-aim has been updated to choose between nearby enemies better, and also comes with a strength slider in the settings menu. It will now also track jumping enemies or enemies with a displaced hitbox (such as enemies with a jetpack) better.

[b]Window Settings:[/b]
[list]
[*]Cursor now can’t leave the game window when the game is unpaused.
[*]Game doesn’t continue to play while not focused on the window.
[/list]
[h3][b]Other QOL:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]Hearts and Starshards should now always drop inside the room when dropped by a miniboss outside of a room.
[*]Bosses no longer attack after being defeated or before finishing dialogue.
[*]Small enemies no longer drop after bosses are defeated or before finished dialogue (Hydra).
[*]During the escort mission, players will go to the areas where they need to complete the quest instead of random zones.
[*]When fighting Jupiter, camera no longer follows Jupiter awkwardly.
[*]When you enter a portal, bullets get cleared (should mean not getting hit in the next room from slow moving bullets).
[*]3000 coins achievement has been dropped to 2500- something more manageable after coin drops were reduced.
[/list]
[h3][b]Bug Fixing:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]Hearts can no longer be grabbed by two players at the same time.
[*]Fixed music overlap/incorrect music in later zones after boss fights.
[*]Fixed Mars visual error on freeze.
[*]Lil Favor rocket should now wait until bosses finish their dialogue.
[*]Sheriff should no longer create chains after death.
[*]Settings sliders will no longer show the wrong value on start.
[*]Frozen planets now take damage correctly.
[*]Fixed Jupiter shaking the screen after death.
[*]Fixed main menu disappearing when using Escape button from the settings menu.
[/list]
[h3][b]Clarity and Visuals:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]Rock obstacles no longer appear on the end screen when completing a run.
[*]Added missing Sheriff death explosion.
[*]Black bars no longer should cover dialogue in widescreen.
[*]Planet introduction bar should now strength to fit widescreen.
[*]Pets no longer listed as active items when appearing in chests.
[*]Fixed missing indicator on sub-menus (“Would you like to quit current run?”).
[*]Fixed text shadow error on sub-menu (“Would you like to quit current run?”).
[/list]
I’m trying to make sure I see all the suggestions wherever they’re posted, but the best place to talk directly to me and either report bugs or give suggestions is the [url=https://discord.gg/uPacfKDsnA]Discord[/url]! I am starting to work on new zones so it's a great time to suggest new enemies and items!

Mark 

Follow me on 
[url=https://twitter.com/m3smay]Twitter [/url]

notes.title: Patch #2
notes.content:
Hi everyone- a small patch here to add on to the one from a couple days ago.

[h3][b]BUG FIXES[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug where re-rolling planet chests would grant bonus hearts and coins
[*]Fixed a space where portals could spawn in a wall in Jupiter
[*]Fixed music tracks changing to the wrong track after boss fights
[*]Fixed items not saving in casual mode in Comet Spaceways
[*]Pets achievement happens at 5 pets as stated rather than 6
[*]Jupiter wont continue to shake the screen after being defeated
[*]Tavern NPC now gives 60 coins as stated
[*]Fixed a bug which prevented Hydra from using infest on Jupiter
[/list]

[h3][b]BALANCING [/b][/h3]

[list]
[*]Hydra’s host now takes damage vs bosses scaling with its max hp- high hp hosts will still get killed in a couple of shots
[*]Reduced the number of small enemies that spawn with the miniboss on Comet Spaceways and Jupiter
[*]Crates are a little less likely to drop unusual hearts
[*]Taunting Cape now requires a 4 cursed run to unlock rather than 5
[*]Battle Thirst now requires a 5 cursed run to unlock rather than 6
[/list]

[h3][b]CLARITY, VISUAL, AND UPDATES[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]Crate coins now auto-collect
[*]The hungry tavern NPC now eats hydra’s host if trading for coins
[*]New sound effects for cultrunt, giant mooncrab and Jupiter attacks
[*]Updated Rage Virus text to specify the boost lasts for the first 2 seconds after taking a host
[*]Advanced runs past Saturn will now always start in the Asteroid Temple
[*]Added sound effects for crates ,chests, planet chests landing
[*]Updated Comet Spaceways music with the full length track
[/list]

Mark

notes.title: Patch #1
notes.content:
Hi everyone- Asterogues’ first patch is now live! Here’s a breakdown of what it contains:

[h3][b]Content:[/b][/h3]

[b]2 NEW ZONES AVAILABLE[/b]
There was a missing link after defeating Saturn that was not allowing players to reach the second half of the content. This is now fixed, so you can fight the middle planets!

[b]SECRET 4TH CHARACTER AVAILABLE[/b]
Fixing the link also gives access to a new character in the later half of the game!

[b]CURSED HUB SHOP AVAILABLE[/b]
This also gives access to the cursed shop at the hub, which acts as difficulty modifiers for harder runs. This is paired with 3 new achievements for completing cursed runs!

[b]HYDRA MECHANICS CHANGE[/b]
Hydra is having a small tweak to its boss buff. Instead of preventing hosts from dying when firing its last HP against a boss, it now slowly restores host HP when fighting a boss. This will make it so you can fight a boss while controlling a stronger enemy that fires more than 1 HP at a time, but need to pace yourself a little if you want to maintain the host.

[h3][b]BUG FIXES[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]Co-op input issues with melee and dialogue fixed
[*]Fixed items being added to the pool before being unlocked
[*]Items from boss chests are now retained through death in casual mode
[*]Character unlocks now pop up when you win the run instead of only when you lose a run
[*]The game is better at snapping players back to the platform when falling off
[*]Fixed a bug that was guaranteeing heart drops for the first two hits taken in every room
[*]Hydra now controls several enemies correctly- Frosquire, Eskaboom, Electric-link enemies, Voidude
[*]Fixed Echo Bullet and Meteor Shower bugs on Hydra when controlling enemies with unique bullet patterns
[*]Uranus suck attack should now affect both players in co-op correctly
[*]Fixed a bug where Uranus chains could keep pulling a player after they were destroyed
[/list]

[h3][b]BALANCING[/b][/h3]
Overall, there was a focus on making runs less overpowered so there’s more interacting with the mechanics of the game. Players had an excess of money and it meant no real decision-making in shops. [i][b]And blowing everything up with a single click was funny, but not every run![/b][/i]
[list]
[*]Coin drops rescaled to 60% of previous
[*]Item quality scales with zones cleared
[*]Big Stick extra radius nerfed from +80% to +50%
[*]Temporarily removed Apollo Boots from the item pool
[/list]

[h3][b]CLARITY AND VISUALS[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]Auto-use items now no longer are listed as Active Items or say “Right Click to use”
[*]Donated Heart now gives 2HP as stated instead of 1
[*]Leafblower text updated to remove mention of blowing away enemies
[*]Wrong key mentioned on Void’s tutorial now fixed
[*]Void and Hydra have correctly positioned graphics firing out of cannons
[*]Screen now snaps back to normal after defeating Uranus if he was spinning it
[*]Player sprites should now follow Starthur’s car correctly
[/list]

I would love to hear your feedback on how the new hp drops and item frequency feels.
Thanks all for your patience and support this first week- as things start to take shape, the focus will move more towards adding in community suggestions so please continue making content, sharing, giving suggestions and memeing! As always, the best way to be seen quickly is through the[url=https://discord.gg/uPacfKDsnA?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=community] Discord[/url]!

Mark
